description: Fast suite 4 cases that need no Argon2id. ent_separation: the round message carries BE32(ENT) after the settings, so equal settings, round and leading half bytes give different salt and mask inputs for each entropy size; the mask uses a fixed public key in place of an Argon2id output. refusals: a 24-word source for suite 4, and every combination of a chosen original length, a selected suite or both with a container word count that the recovery table of the specification rejects; each must be rejected before any Argon2id work. Values computed independently with Python's hashlib and hmac; the refusals follow the table.
